name: streamed-text-loader
title: Streamed Text Loader
description: Text that animates in as a model streams it: only the newly received characters reveal, in one of 16 styles (focus, decode, typewriter, skeleton, wipe, terminal and more).
author: Kasturi Khanke <https://github.com/kasturibuilds>
docs:
Installed `StreamedTextLoader` (`@/components/ui/streamed-text-loader`), with its styles inside the file (React 19 hoists them into `<head>` once) and `motion` for the reveals.

```tsx
import { StreamedTextLoader } from "@/components/ui/streamed-text-loader";

<StreamedTextLoader text={partialReply} variant="focus" color="currentColor" />
```

Pass the reply received so far as `text` and append to it as chunks stream in: only the new characters animate. `color="currentColor"` follows your theme; `variant="skeleton"` shows placeholder bars while `text` is empty. Motion stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`. Motion renders each reveal's first frame on the server (fresh characters start transparent), so for server-rendered text pass `paused` until the page hydrates, as the demo does.

Ported from generative-loaders (`TextLoader`) by Kasturi Khanke (MIT); the license notice is at the end of the file.
